name: realtime-avatar-sdk
description: Realtime Avatar SDK — live voice and video characters you can interrupt.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p libs/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p libs/sdk-server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p libs/sdk-react/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w libs/http-client && npm run build -w libs/tools && npm run build -w libs/browser && npm run build -w libs/proxy && npm run build -w libs/client && npm run build -w libs/sdk-server && npm run build -w libs/sdk-react && npm run build -w libs/mcp
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run boundary && npm run messages && npm run surface
